content.comment_body: Can someone advise on how to transfer logic from a [product_name] controller with [article_no] to [product_name] software [version_no]? I'm unable to see the controller in the 'Add New Device' section of 'Network View'.
When using network mode, controllers with [article_no] from 0BA0 to 0BA6 are not supported—only [article_no] 0BA7 and 0BA8 have networking capabilities.

This thread is closed since the question was posted twice. The related discussion with subject 'Unable to find [product_name] controller [article_no] in hardware catalog of [product_name] software [version_no]' is available in the conference dedicated to [product_name]. Kind regards, [user_name]
